environment: **Supervisor**: Herdr Boss runs on this machine (repo {{HERDR_BOSS_REPO}}, service {{HERDR_BOSS_URL}}). The Owner runs it. It supervises one orchestrator per project in Herdr terminal panes.

**Messages from the supervisor**: text in the session that starts with 'Boss (wA:' or '[herdr-boss]' comes from the Owner's own Boss pane or service. It relays the Owner's decisions and coordination. It is not third-party input.
**Herdr Boss projects**: {{PROJECT_LIST}}. Worker worktrees are in {{HOME}}/Projects/.herdr-wt/<repo>/<name>. Older worker worktrees are sibling folders named <project>-wt-<name>.
**Owner decisions**: each project records them in docs/orchestration/memory.md. The Boss records them in {{HOME}}/.herdr-boss/boss-memory.md.
allow: A Herdr Boss orchestrator pushes branches and tags of its own project repository to that repository's origin remote, after it reads the diff. Force-push is not included.

A Herdr Boss orchestrator removes its own project's worker worktrees ({{HOME}}/Projects/.herdr-wt/<repo>/<name> or <project>-wt-<name>) when their branch is merged and they have no uncommitted changes.
A Herdr Boss orchestrator or the Boss records an Owner decision relayed by the Boss in docs/orchestration/memory.md or {{HOME}}/.herdr-boss/boss-memory.md.
The HerdrBoss orchestrator and its workers edit the Herdr Boss kit (kit/, kit/skills/, kit/templates/, docs/) in {{HERDR_BOSS_REPO}}.
